summary: Cheche Group Inc. furnished a Form 6-K announcing an extraordinary general meeting to approve a 35-for-1 share consolidation and related charter amendments. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is involved. The meeting is scheduled for June 12, 2026, with a record date of May 22, 2026. This is a routine capital-structure adjustment filing, not a special situation.
